text:
anna-w: FYI — we'll start the staged rollout for runtime v2.3-kernel at 23:10 UTC. This changes the KV eviction heuristic and a router header flag. pin proposal: API/console -> v2.2 for wave1, runtime -> v2.3-canary.
samir: Sounds good. What are the canary health gates?
anna-w: basic gates: 5xx rate < 0.1%, p50 latency delta < 10ms, kv-miss-rate change < 0.5%. Also run the canary traffic with header: X-RW-Test=runtime-canary.
maria: I'll enable the console route pin and freeze release notes patching. linking the notes here: https://go/release/notes/617555-rt-kernel (do not merge until green) :lock:
igor: Router team: when you flip header routing, we need the fallback path intact for 10m and router metrics to show no increase in 502/504s. We'll watch the header swap metric: router.header.swap.failures.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot triggered: starting wave 1 canary rollout -> runtime:v2.3-canary (10% traffic) at 2026-03-21T23:10:00Z. Notifying on-call.
leah: On-call acked. I'll run a short smoke set against the API endpoints that exercise prefix caching and KV access.
maria: Console pinned to v2.2, API pinned to v2.2. Documented pin in the release ticket.
anna-w: If KV miss-rate spikes > 0.5% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets -> immediate rollback criteria. Also if router.header.swap.failures > 1% in 5m -> rollback.
samir: Quick check: do we have a runtime fallback artifact? Can we flip to v2.2 runtime if things go south?
igor: Yes — runtime has a compatibility shim. Rollback steps: 1) push runtime v2.2 pin to orchestrator, 2) revert router header flag, 3) unpin console/api after stability, 4) run a staged traffic drain. I've pasted the commands for the operator: \n```\n# rollback runtime\nrzctl deploy set runtime --version v2.2 --zone=all --priority=high\nrzctl router flip-header --flag=disable-runtime-canary\n```\nmaria: Also add a manual checklist step for CS to hold customer-facing announcements until wave1 is green.
leah: During the canary I'm going to tail these two dashboards: rt-kernel/kv-evictions and router/header-swap. Will post screenshots if anything looks odd. :eyes:
deploy-bot: wave1 complete: runtime:v2.3-canary at 10% steady for 6m, health gates: p50 delta +6ms, 5xx rate 0.03%, kv-miss-rate +0.12% -> PASS. Proceeding to wave2 (33%).
anna-w: Good. Start wave2 but keep API/console pins in place. Wave2 observe window 15m.
igor: Router will enable gradual header ramp on north-south and keep fallback for 10m after each step.
samir: Note for release notes: callout about kv eviction tuning and backward-compatible router header — include rollback playbook snippet.
maria: I've updated the ticket and release note draft. Dropped the patch link into the ticket.
leah: Wave2 at 33% started. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: wave2 progress: 33% for 10m -> health gates green. No anomalies in router.header.swap.failures.
leah: Seeing a small uptick in long-tail latency on one host pool, investigating.
anna-w: If it's isolated to one host pool, we'll cordon that pool and continue; if cross-pool, rollback. @igor can you prepare the cordon play?
igor: prepping cordon play. Command: `rzctl node cordon --pool=pool-eta-3`. If cordon doesn't drop error rate within 5m, escalate to rollback.
leah: cordon executed, error rate on pool-eta-3 back to baseline. Continuing ramp.
deploy-bot: wave3 ramp -> 100% (gradual over 10m). Final observe window 20m.
maria: Once we hit stable 20m, I'll unpin console/api and merge release note, then send the customer-facing blurb.
samir: Reminder: tag the canary flags in the config repo and add a short note for infra on why we reverted the old kv threshold.
anna-w: We're through the 20m stable window with no regressions. Unpinning consoles now and starting post-rollout validations.
maria: Release notes merged. Marking release ticket as done-pending-monitoring.
igor: I'll follow up with a quick action item: open a follow-up story to capture telemetry improvement for router.header.swap metric granularity.
leah: Thanks everyone. Small retrospective: consider adding a synthetic that exercises cold-KV misses before future kernel flips. :+1:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete -> runtime:v2.3 (stable) rolled to 100% at 2026-03-21T23:55:20Z. Logs: https://go/logs/rollout/6175552222
anna-w: Great job. Closing the loop — if any post-rollout signal breaches the thresholds we defined, reopen this thread.
